name: std::swap(std::basic_string)
intro:
Specializes the std::swap algorithm for std::basic_string. Swaps the contents of lhs and rhs.

Equivalent to lhs.swap(rhs).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs

 -

 strings whose contents to swap

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text:
Constant.

Exceptions
noexcept specification:  
noexcept(noexcept(lhs.swap(rhs)))

(since C++17)

examples.output:
Before swap:
a = AAA
b = BBBB
 
After swap:
a = BBBB
b = AAA
